items.title: Fiji National Day
items.summary: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State Fiji National Day Press Statement October 9, 2026 On behalf of the United States of America, I extend my warmest congratulations to the people of Fiji as you celebrate your national day. Today is an opportunity to honor Fiji’s rich history and cultural heritage. The United States values our strong partnership with Fiji, built on our shared commitment to prosperity, peace, and security in the Pacific. Our ongoing work together through the Millennium Challenge Corporation is laying the foundation for the U.S.-Fiji partnership to reach new heights in years to come.
